questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the study of matter and energy'?
explanation: Physics is correct - P-H-Y-S-I-C-S. Physics is the branch of science dealing with matter and energy.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a living thing'?
explanation: Organism is correct - O-R-G-A-N-I-S-M. An organism is any living thing.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the path a planet travels around the sun'?
explanation: Orbit is correct - O-R-B-I-T. An orbit is the curved path of an object around a star or planet.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a tiny unit of matter'?
explanation: Atom is correct - A-T-O-M. An atom is the smallest unit of a chemical element.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the force that pulls objects downward'?
explanation: Gravity is correct - G-R-A-V-I-T-Y. Gravity is the force that attracts objects toward each other.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a shape with six equal sides'?
explanation: Hexagon is correct - H-E-X-A-G-O-N. A hexagon is a six-sided polygon.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a shape with eight sides'?
explanation: Octagon is correct - O-C-T-A-G-O-N. An octagon has eight sides and angles.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the distance around a circle'?
explanation: Circumference is correct - C-I-R-C-U-M-F-E-R-E-N-C-E. The circumference is the perimeter of a circle.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a tool used to measure angles'?
explanation: Protractor is correct - P-R-O-T-R-A-C-T-O-R. A protractor measures angles in degrees.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a number that divides evenly into another'?
explanation: Factor is correct - F-A-C-T-O-R. A factor divides another number without leaving a remainder.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a substance that speeds up a reaction'?
explanation: Catalyst is correct - C-A-T-A-L-Y-S-T. A catalyst speeds up a chemical reaction without being consumed.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the smallest unit of life'?
explanation: Cell is correct - C-E-L-L. A cell is the basic structural unit of all living organisms. Double L.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the changing of a substance from liquid to gas'?
explanation: Evaporation is correct - E-V-A-P-O-R-A-T-I-O-N. Evaporation is when liquid turns into vapor.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a substance made of two or more elements'?
explanation: Compound is correct - C-O-M-P-O-U-N-D. A compound is a substance formed from two or more elements.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the science of the stars'?
explanation: Astronomy is correct - A-S-T-R-O-N-O-M-Y. Astronomy is the study of stars and the universe.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a unit of electrical power'?
explanation: Watt is correct - W-A-T-T. A watt is a unit of power. Double T.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the study of living things'?
explanation: Biology is correct - B-I-O-L-O-G-Y. Biology is the science of life and living organisms.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the outer layer of the Earth'?
explanation: Crust is correct - C-R-U-S-T. The crust is the outermost solid layer of Earth.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'tiny living things seen through a microscope'?
explanation: Microbes is correct - M-I-C-R-O-B-E-S. Microbes are microscopic organisms.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the process plants use to make food'?
explanation: Photosynthesis is correct - P-H-O-T-O-S-Y-N-T-H-E-S-I-S. Plants convert light into food through photosynthesis.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the passing of traits from parent to offspring'?
explanation: Heredity is correct - H-E-R-E-D-I-T-Y. Heredity is the passing of genetic traits from parents to children.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a positively charged particle in an atom'?
explanation: Proton is correct - P-R-O-T-O-N. A proton is a positively charged particle found in an atomic nucleus.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a negatively charged particle'?
explanation: Electron is correct - E-L-E-C-T-R-O-N. An electron is a negatively charged subatomic particle.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a device that converts solar energy to electricity'?
explanation: Photovoltaic is correct - P-H-O-T-O-V-O-L-T-A-I-C. Photovoltaic cells convert sunlight to electricity.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the bending of light through water or glass'?
explanation: Refraction is correct - R-E-F-R-A-C-T-I-O-N. Refraction is the bending of light as it passes through a medium.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the ratio of a circle diameter to circumference'?
explanation: Pi is correct - P-I. Pi is the mathematical constant approximately equal to 3.14159.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the study of the composition of substances'?
explanation: Chemistry is correct - C-H-E-M-I-S-T-R-Y. Chemistry is the science of substances and their properties.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a chart showing elements and their properties'?
explanation: Periodic table is correct - P-E-R-I-O-D-I-C T-A-B-L-E. The periodic table organizes all known chemical elements.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'having two poles like a magnet'?
explanation: Bipolar is correct - B-I-P-O-L-A-R. Bipolar means having two opposite poles or extremes.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the science of designing structures'?
explanation: Engineering is correct - E-N-G-I-N-E-E-R-I-N-G. Engineering is the application of science to design and build structures.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a number that can only be divided by 1 and itself'?
explanation: Prime is correct - P-R-I-M-E. A prime number has no divisors other than 1 and itself.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the study of the Earth'?
explanation: Geology is correct - G-E-O-L-O-G-Y. Geology is the science of the structure and history of Earth.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a mathematical statement that two things are equal'?
explanation: Equation is correct - E-Q-U-A-T-I-O-N. An equation shows that two expressions are equal.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the branch of math dealing with shapes'?
explanation: Geometry is correct - G-E-O-M-E-T-R-Y. Geometry is the branch of mathematics dealing with shapes.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'relating to numbers and calculation'?
explanation: Numerical is correct - N-U-M-E-R-I-C-A-L. Numerical relates to numbers.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a change in position over time'?
explanation: Velocity is correct - V-E-L-O-C-I-T-Y. Velocity is the speed of something in a given direction.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the amount of matter in an object'?
explanation: Mass is correct - M-A-S-S. Mass is the amount of matter an object contains. Double S.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the force exerted by gravity on an object'?
explanation: Weight is correct - W-E-I-G-H-T. Weight is the gravitational force acting on an object.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a unit of distance in space'?
explanation: Light year is correct - L-I-G-H-T Y-E-A-R. A light year is the distance light travels in one year.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the property of an object to resist change in motion'?
explanation: Inertia is correct - I-N-E-R-T-I-A. Inertia is the tendency of an object to resist changes in its state of motion.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a material that allows electricity to flow'?
explanation: Conductor is correct - C-O-N-D-U-C-T-O-R. A conductor allows electricity or heat to flow through it.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a material that blocks electricity'?
explanation: Insulator is correct - I-N-S-U-L-A-T-O-R. An insulator prevents the flow of electricity or heat.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the distance from the center to the edge of a circle'?
explanation: Radius is correct - R-A-D-I-U-S. The radius is the distance from the center of a circle to its edge.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the distance across a circle through its center'?
explanation: Diameter is correct - D-I-A-M-E-T-E-R. The diameter is the full width of a circle through its center.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a number multiplied by itself'?
explanation: Square is correct - S-Q-U-A-R-E. The square of a number is that number multiplied by itself.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the process of breaking a substance into parts'?
explanation: Decomposition is correct - D-E-C-O-M-P-O-S-I-T-I-O-N. Decomposition is the breaking down of matter.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'a substance with a pH below 7'?
explanation: Acid is correct - A-C-I-D. An acid is a substance with a pH lower than 7.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'having the same measure on both sides'?
explanation: Symmetrical is correct - S-Y-M-M-E-T-R-I-C-A-L. Double M. Symmetrical means having matching halves.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the use of coded instructions for computers'?
explanation: Algorithm is correct - A-L-G-O-R-I-T-H-M. An algorithm is a step-by-step set of instructions.

questionText: Which is the CORRECT spelling of a word meaning 'the outer boundary of a shape'?
explanation: Perimeter is correct - P-E-R-I-M-E-T-E-R. The perimeter is the total distance around a shape.
